native_sample_path.result: PASS: generated PCM is selected, resampled into the voice slab and emitted by the untouched stock renderer.

live_pipeline_correction.previous_simplification: The compact static harness called the outbound handoff directly with the renderer frame slab.
live_pipeline_correction.observed_isr: The live ISR adds external-audio lanes, runs ring selection/extraction, and passes 0x80007440 to 0x40109F04.
live_pipeline_correction.interpretation: Those sources belong to the external audio-interface ring and are distinct from the successfully rendered sample ring. A zero 0x80007440 buffer does not invalidate native sample rendering.

defects_fixed: ELINK-enabled CITER/BITER counts use the low 9 bits rather than all low 15 bits.
SOFF and DOFF advance after each transfer element, not once per minor loop.
CSR.START initiates a software request and supports self-linked minor loops.
CSR.ESG loads the next 32-byte TCD from DLASTSG instead of adding that pointer to DADDR.
edma_gate.runtime_proof: Channel 30 reached CSR 0x0081, the stock ISR returned from handoff 0x40109F04, and channel 42 was programmed/completed with CSR 0x0081.

next_gate.name: AR172_QEMU_DESKTOP_AUDIO_TAP_GATE
next_gate.objective: Expose the nonzero stock renderer ring as a paced host-audio stream, mixing the eight rendered lanes without depending on absent physical analog-interface return lanes.

safety: All firmware execution and trace interventions remained local. No firmware, extracted MAIN, project data, factory sample names, or proprietary PCM are included.
